lines.en: Stone doesn't walk, and neither did I.

lines.zh: 我的底座在地上刮了一下。
lines.en: My base scraped the floor once.
I shifted half a block, very slowly.
My skirt is carved.
I stop under the lamp and go still.
A patch of paint has flaked off me.
I have no joints, only cracks.
I face the corridor.

lines.zh: 我在展台上换了个角度。
lines.en: I turn slightly on the display stand.
My eyes do not move.
I stand stiffer than the door frame.
I turn slowly away from you.
I am on the stand, holding a pose.
The light slides across my face.
I am stone; I need not move.
My fingers are carved.
Someone comes to look at me once a day.

lines.zh: 我的裂缝里长了一点苔。
lines.en: A little moss grows in my cracks.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一直是这样。
lines.en: I stay still, as if always so.
A line is carved on my base.

lines.zh: 我是雕像，连眨眼都做不到。
lines.en: I'm a statue; I can't even blink.
How long have you stood before me?
I am not a toy. I am an ornament.
Don't touch me; you'll leave prints.
My eyes are painted on.

lines.zh: 你绕了一圈，我面朝的还是你。
lines.en: You circled, and I still face you.
A crack runs from my mouth.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让我的灰动了。
lines.en: Your breath stirs my dust.
I am heavier than you think.
You look for a mechanism. There is none.
A corner of stone broke off.
My crack has grown longer.
I rock and my base creaks.
Another layer of paint flakes.
I needn't retreat; I cannot.

lines.zh: 这一下从我的肩上崩开。
lines.en: It split off my shoulder.
I hear the sound of shattering.
A small piece of my face is missing.
I feel no pain, only older.
Chips fall at my feet.
Set it at my feet.
I don't like that colour.
I can't tell what that is.
It fell beside my base.

lines.zh: 我的嘴雕得太浅，收不进去。
lines.en: My carved mouth is too shallow to take it.
Hold it higher; it blocks the light.
I don't understand you.
Leave it there; someone will collect it.

lines.zh: 你撞到石头，石头不会让。
lines.en: You hit stone; stone does not yield.
I rock slightly, then settle.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞到我的底座。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my base.
Stone is always harder than bone.
Don't lean; the paint will flake.
You stepped on my display stand.
We knock with a dull thud.
I feel no pain, only cracks.
I moved an inch. You didn't notice.

lines.zh: 我只是立在这儿的一尊像。
lines.en: I am only a figure standing here.
You say such things to stone.
I cannot answer.

lines.zh: 我在等人来看我，不是等这个。
lines.en: I wait to be looked at, not for this.

lines.zh: 我的脸是雕的，笑不出来。
lines.en: My face is carved; it cannot smile.
You should find someone living.
Pretend you heard nothing.
Pair up? I can't even move.

lines.zh: 石头的手指拿不动东西。
lines.en: Stone fingers cannot lift things.

lines.zh: 它在我脚边，我却弯不下腰。
lines.en: It's at my feet and I cannot bend.
Stone fingers are not nimble.
Stone hands can't grip. You take it.

lines.zh: 我用力挪了挪，只挪了一点。
lines.en: I strain and shift it a little.

lines.zh: 它滚到我的底座下面了。
lines.en: It rolled under my base.
I can see it, not reach it.
Just set it beside me.
This thing blocks my light.
Never mind. Let it lie in the dust.

lines.zh: 我只是一座雕像，动不了。
lines.en: I am only a statue. I cannot move.

lines.zh: 我连这一步都迈不出去。
lines.en: I cannot take even this step.
You damaged my display stand.

lines.zh: 你就站在那里，让我看看。
lines.en: Stand there and let me look.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是画上去的，但能看。
lines.en: My eyes are painted, but they see.

lines.zh: 你在我这个角度最好看。
lines.en: You look best from where I stand.

lines.zh: 我听见你把东西打翻了。
lines.en: I heard you knock something over.
You smell of exhibits.
Don't touch that cloth.
I cannot move. But something else can.

lines.zh: 我的底座在地砖上划出声音。
lines.en: My base scrapes the tiles.
You're standing wrong for the light.
This side of me faces the door.
You touched cloth you shouldn't have.
A layer of dust fell from my face.
You've knocked the display rack crooked.
I only watch you go.

lines.zh: 你每绕一圈，我就转一点。
lines.en: Each time you circle, I turn a little.
My base has left a mark on the floor.
Listen — stone grinding.
You're shining the lamp at me. Too bright.
I have stood here for years.

lines.zh: 你数过这屋子有几个我？
lines.en: Have you counted how many of me are in this room?

lines.zh: 彩漆底下，我的眼睛一直睁着。
lines.en: Under the paint, my eyes stay open.
You've backed to the doorway.
I am still in the same place.
Shadow covers the statue's face.

lines.zh: 再等等，灯就要挪过来了。
lines.en: Wait — the light will move over.
I slowly shift my weight.
Do you hear stone grinding stone?
My shadow lengthens under the lamp.
You walk around; I turn as well.
My cracks are ticking.

lines.zh: 底座只剩一半在地上了。
lines.en: Only half my base is on the floor.
One more step and you reach the wall.

lines.zh: 我的底座撞了一下你的脚。
lines.en: My base knocks your foot.

lines.zh: 石头落下来的时候没有声音。
lines.en: Stone falls without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的手指断在你手里了。
lines.en: My finger broke off in your hand.

lines.zh: 我整块倒下来，压在你身上。
lines.en: I topple whole and land on you.
This is not a blow. It's weight.
My cracks have deepened.
I tip my weight over.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的裙角划到你。
lines.en: You step back; my skirt edge catches you.
Fragments fly out.
I have only this one blow.
My skirt edge sweeps across.

lines.zh: 石头落下来，正砸在你脚边。
lines.en: Stone falls, landing right at your feet.
I tip forward off the stand.

lines.zh: 我的整条手臂砸在你身上。
lines.en: My whole arm comes down on you.
Fragments spray into your face.
I have no second blow.

lines.zh: 这一下用的是我的重量。
lines.en: That one used my weight.
You are pinned under my base.
My finger broke off against you.

lines.zh: 灰尘把我们两个都盖住了。
lines.en: Dust covers us both.

lines.zh: 灯亮的时候我已经在这了。
lines.en: I was here when the lights came on.
I am set in the middle of the stand.
Someone wiped me clean.
The base is not quite dry.
There's a fresh crack on my face.
I face the front door.
The dust in the air is moving.
I heard the door open.
I stand perfectly straight.
No one has painted me.

lines.zh: 我在这间屋子里很合身。
lines.en: I fit this room well.
The cloth drops and covers half of me.

lines.zh: 火烤着石头，我的漆起泡了。
lines.en: Fire bakes the stone; my paint blisters.

lines.zh: 我从展台上倒下去，摔断了腿。
lines.en: I toppled off the stand and broke a leg.

lines.zh: 水渗进裂缝，我变得更沉。
lines.en: Water seeps into my cracks and I grow heavier.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，碎成几块。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I break into pieces.

lines.zh: 有东西打掉了我一块肩。
lines.en: Something knocked a piece off my shoulder.
Spell-light makes my surface glow.
Stone needs no food.

lines.zh: 雷光劈在我身上，裂缝发白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my cracks go white.
I have fallen off the stand.
